verdict.rationale: Gide's IT, Digital & Cybersecurity practice names an offering called "Protection for software, open source and databases," so open source is a named area of counsel. The accompanying description only covers IP issues and protecting digital assets in general terms; it does not mention license compliance or OSS usage policies. Missing for 10: explicit description of open-source license compliance advice, OSS usage policy drafting for product companies, and any matter references or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability

citations.quote: Protection for software, open source and databases
We help our clients apprehend intellectual property issues surrounding new technologies, and the various techniques for protecting their digital assets.
